decision: How should authorization behave when the generated named-skills index cannot be read or parsed?
whyItMatters: Treating missing or corrupt authorization data as bootstrap silently lets every actor run mutating commands.
evidence: Founder ruling 2026-11-08: "Fail closed on unreadable or malformed index; empty registry keeps bootstrap; override still works"
A missing or unreadable registry/named-skills.json is not the genuine empty-registry bootstrap condition. CI and fresh environments that must mutate can set GAIA_OPERATOR_OVERRIDE=1.
recommended: Deny with the index path and repair guidance; preserve bootstrap only for a readable index containing zero 4★+ verifiers; always honor GAIA_OPERATOR_OVERRIDE=1.
alternative: Treat missing or malformed authorization data as bootstrap.
unblocks: Fail-closed Verifier authorization with an explicit CI override.
